browser_playable: true — free browser demo + full game at https://melvoridle.com (Play in browser); also Steam/mobile
what_it_is: Idle/incremental RuneScape-inspired RPG that is entirely menu-driven (skills, combat, bank, shop) with persistent leveling.
how_similar_to_abyssal: Persistent left progression rail (Combat / Passive / Non-combat skills, each showing X/99 level) + main content panel — structurally the same left-dock-of-progression-tabs around a content area that Abyssal Surge's outgame uses for stats/skilltree/traits.
